apps.title: Transformers: Eternal War
apps.summary:
Autobots and Decepticons stand united against the Chaos Legion! Experience an all-new Transformers Strategy Idle RPG featuring an original story by Simon Furman!

The Earth has been consumed by a mysterious force born from pure chaos energy—an unstoppable corruption now spreading toward humanity’s final line of defense.
For generations, Autobots and Decepticons have waged an unrelenting war. But in the face of the Chaos Legion—as heroes and villains fight against the chaos—old enmities must be set aside.
The fight for Earth is no longer about victory. It is about survival.

◆ Forge an Original Transformers Epic with Simon Furman ◆
Transformers: Eternal War features an original story written by Simon Furman, the legendary writer who helped define the Transformers universe for generations of fans.
In this all-new chapter, players will uncover the rise of the Chaos Legion, an apocalyptic faction empowered by unstable chaos energy. As its influence spreads, iconic Autobots and Decepticons must unite against a corruption threatening Earth, Cybertron, and the future of the universe.
Faced with a threat unlike anything they have ever encountered, Autobots and Decepticons must confront an impossible choice: continue their endless war—or stand together to protect Earth, Cybertron, and the future of all they fight for.

◆ Lead the Combat Through Strategic Command ◆
Transformers: Eternal War evolves the character-collector experience with a streamlined system focused on tactical squad-building and strategic progression over constant micromanagement.
Whether online or away from the battlefield, your forces continue fighting, gathering resources, and advancing the war effort around the clock. Recruit, upgrade, and command an ever-expanding roster of iconic Transformers while assembling powerful team synergies capable of turning the tide of battle.
Every squad composition matters. Every commander shapes the future of the conflict.

◆ Build the Ark. Sustain the Battle. ◆
Beyond the battlefield, players can expand and manage support facilities surrounding the Ark, creating a steady flow of resources that keeps their forces combat-ready at all times.
By upgrading automated production systems and optimizing resource operations, commanders can continuously strengthen their squads. Even while offline, your facilities remain active—gathering supplies, supporting troop growth, and preparing your forces for the next conflict.
Designed around a seamless hands-off experience, Transformers: Eternal War allows players to focus less on repetitive maintenance and more on assembling powerful teams, developing strategy, and pushing back against the growing Chaos Legion threat.

◆ A New Era of Transformers Warfare Begins ◆
Combining legendary characters, an original story crafted by one of the franchise’s most iconic writers, and a modern strategic gameplay experience built for mobile, Transformers: Eternal War delivers both a celebration of Transformers history and a bold new evolution for the franchise.

——The universe is changing.
——The signal has been broadcast.
——Now the fate of Earth depends on who answers the call！

apps.title: Wordsect - Word Puzzle Games
apps.summary:
Wordsect combines crossword puzzles with connected letter tiles and satisfying tile breaks. Find words on the letter board, fill the crossword grid, and plan which tiles to use next.

The numbers change how you play. Each tile has a limited number of uses, shown on its face. Use a tile to form a word and its count goes down. When the count reaches zero, it cracks and crumbles. A word that fits now may use letters you need later, so look beyond your next answer.

HOW TO PLAY
- Connect neighboring letters up, down, left, or right to form words.
- Find words that fit the crossword grid.
- Check the numbers to track each tile's remaining uses.
- Watch a tile break apart when its count reaches zero.

CROSSWORDS WITH AN EXTRA CHALLENGE
Solving the crossword is only part of the puzzle. Explore letter paths and consider how each word affects the tiles still available. Put vocabulary, spelling, and planning together as you work towards a completed grid.

A SATISFYING WAY TO FIND WORDS
Letter tiles crack and crumble when they are used up, giving each puzzle a distinctive visual rhythm. Enjoy the word-finding challenge and the satisfying break-apart moments along the way.

LARGE LETTERS, READABLE COUNTS
See the letters and remaining-use numbers clearly as you study the board. Compare possible connections, choose a word, and make your next move.

If you enjoy crossword games and connecting letters, try a word puzzle where finding an answer and choosing a path go hand in hand.

Connect the letters. Complete the crossword. Enjoy the crumble.

apps.title: Factifact: Trivia Word Puzzle
apps.summary:
Factifact is a trivia word puzzle that turns fun facts into wordplay. 🔍 Each short fact hides some of its words inside brackets. Read the definitions, find the missing words and reveal the whole fact.

How does a Factifact word game work? A fact appears with some words, or parts of words, hidden in brackets. Each bracket holds a short definition of a missing word. Read it and guess the word from four options. No typing is needed, so these logic puzzles stay smooth and focused. Definitions are nested three or four layers deep. The answer to an inner definition becomes a word in the outer one. It feels like trivia questions stacked inside each other. Every word you find brings you closer to interesting facts about the world. 🧠 Think of them as word riddles that test your vocabulary.

Factifact works like a reverse crossword without a grid. ⛏️ Classic crossword puzzles give you a clue and a row of empty squares. Here you start from the clue and dig down to the hidden word. Fans of word puzzle games will feel at home right away. Every brainteaser blends vocabulary, reasoning and general knowledge in one sequence. Short brain teasers like these make a calm mental workout at any time.

Guess the word correctly and the next layer of the puzzle opens. Unlike most word quiz games, every answer becomes part of the next clue. These trivia questions reward careful reading and patient thinking. Solving puzzles here feels like piecing a small story together. What you will find inside:
💡 A hint when a clue feels too tricky
❤️ Three hearts per fact, so every guess counts
🏺 A dig site that uncovers a hidden find with each solved word
📌 A board where every solved fact is pinned as a colorful note
🎉 Confetti, fireworks and kind words when a fact is fully revealed

The facts cover nature, geography, animals and much more. 🏺 One puzzle explains why honey can stay fresh for centuries. Another shows how Mount Everest is still growing. If you enjoy crossword puzzles, these little discoveries will surprise you. Factifact brings word puzzle games and general knowledge together. Expect brain teasers that are short, fair and satisfying to crack.

Facts unlock one after another, and any solved fact can be reread later. 📌 Some logic puzzles are gentle, while others are real brainteasers with deep nesting. A wrong answer costs a heart, so read each clue carefully. Love word quiz games, solving puzzles and interesting facts? 🎉 Factifact is waiting for you.

Welcome to Rope Sort, an engaging color-matching yarn sort puzzle designed to refresh your mind and soothe your senses. Experience the satisfying tactile flow of sliding colorful yarn balls, organizing matching strands across spools, and bringing cozy harmony to every level.

Whether you love classic water sort puzzles, ball sort games, or cozy craft themes, Rope Sort delivers an addictive, stress-free logic challenge for players of all ages.

Simple & Satisfying Gameplay:
🧵 Pick & Slide: Easily tap and drag a yarn ball (or connected chains of the same color) from one rope to another.
🧶 Match by Color: Place your yarn onto an empty spool or align it with a matching yarn ball at the free end.
🧺 Complete & Pack: Fill a full spool with matching shades to watch the yarn bundle pack away into your cozy collection basket!
💡 Plan Ahead: Manage limited rope slots, think ahead, and master every move before running out of space.

Exciting Puzzle Mechanics:
❓ Mystery Yarn Balls: Shift outer yarns to reveal hidden mystery colors and unlock unexpected sorting possibilities.
🔒 Locked Spools & Obstacles: Complete targeted color matches to unlock blocked strands and open up new tactical pathways.
✨ Helpful Boosters: Need an extra hand? Use Undo, smart Hints, or Add an Extra Rope to conquer tricky brain teasers.

Why You'll Love Rope Sort:
🌈 Cozy Tactile Feedback: Enjoy crisp visual animations, vibrant wool textures, and satisfying audio snaps with every slide.
🧠 Brain Training at Your Pace: Sharpen your logic, spatial planning, and problem-solving skills without time pressure or move limits.
📴 Offline Play: Enjoy deep offline puzzle gameplay wherever you go—no Wi-Fi or data connection required.

Take a peaceful break, organize the colorful yarn balls, and master the art of Rope Sort!

apps.title: Bingo Rise
apps.summary:
Bingo Rise is designed for people who find regular alarms too easy to ignore.
If you often hit snooze, turn alarms off half awake, or fall back asleep after a quick tap, Bingo Rise is built to make mornings more active. Instead of relying only on a standard stop button, the app lets you clear your alarm through a Bingo challenge, adding a small but meaningful task before the sound ends.

The goal is not to make wake-ups complicated. It is to make them harder to dismiss without thinking. A short Bingo round gives you a moment of focus, a reason to interact, and a better chance of getting fully awake before going back to sleep.
Bingo Rise is especially suited for people who need a stronger morning routine but still want something simple and enjoyable to use. The Bingo element makes the experience feel lighter and more playful than a harsh alarm, while still helping you get out of bed on time.

With Bingo Rise, you can:
- Create alarms for mornings, naps, routines, and reminders
- Choose one-time alarms or repeating schedules
- Set your preferred ringtone and vibration options
- Dismiss alarms normally or with a Bingo challenge
- Pick different Bingo challenge levels for different wake-up needs
- Manage everything in a clean and easy-to-use layout

Bingo Rise is designed for lazy mornings, heavy sleepers, and anyone who needs a little more help getting started. It turns alarm dismissal into a quick Bingo moment, so waking up feels more engaging, more effective, and a lot less automatic.

apps.title: Pixelora Flow
apps.summary:
Pixelora Flow is a fun brain-teasing 3d adventure that blends colorful worm sliding, strategic block clearing, and exciting clash mechanics! If you enjoy relaxing puzzle games, this pixel art clearing quest is created for you. Match colors, eat bricks, slide to win, and clear 3d puzzles in puzzle games anytime!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
Tap & Summon: Tap the numbered color marbles to summon a vibrant worm onto the 3d grid.
Slide & Eat: Watch your worm slide across the board to eat pixel bricks and avoid a clash.
Avoid the Clash: Keep an eye on capacity! Plan every worm move so no worm triggers a color clash.
Solve 3D Puzzles: Slide and eat away every block to clear 3d puzzles, eat all bricks, and solve puzzles!

✨ GAME FEATURES
Fun 3D Brick Clearing: Immerse yourself in pixel art where every worm can slide, eat matching bricks, and clear 3d puzzles.
Brain-Teasing Puzzle Games: Experience deep logic in puzzle games. Slide your worm smartly to eat bricks so no colors clash.
Relaxing Puzzles & Boosters: Stuck on levels? Use special boosters to clear bricks, slide your worm, eat blocks, and solve hard puzzles.
Endless 3D Challenges: Play creative puzzle games with fresh layouts, 3d bricks to eat, puzzles to solve, and no clash.
ASMR Pixel Clearance: Enjoy smooth slide animations, satisfying eat sounds, crisp bricks popping, and relaxing clash puzzles.

🌟 WHY YOU WILL LOVE PIXELORA FLOW
Unlike traditional puzzle games, Pixelora Flow lets you slide each worm through dynamic 3d grids. Strategy is key: if you fail to match colors, your holding area will fill up and clash. Think ahead, slide every worm to eat target bricks, resolve every clash, and master all 3d puzzles!
Are you ready to slide every worm, eat all bricks, avoid a clash, and win these 3d puzzles? Download Pixelora Flow and enjoy a wonderful puzzle games experience!

What if every question could reveal something unexpected?

Magic Quiz is made for curious minds that enjoy learning without lessons or complicated rules. Every round brings a fresh mix of trivia questions inspired by the world around us. Some answers may feel familiar, while others can completely change the way you see an ordinary subject.

WHY PLAY MAGIC QUIZ?

• Discover interesting facts through simple question-and-answer gameplay
• Explore a rich variety of general knowledge topics
• Encounter familiar subjects and unexpected trivia
• Enjoy an elegant liquid-glass visual style
• Move through questions at a comfortable pace
• Use helpful hints when you need a touch of magic
• Return anytime for another quick quiz or a longer trivia session

A LITTLE MAGIC IN EVERY ANSWER

The rules are simple, but the questions can lead anywhere. One quiz may take you into ancient history, the next into outer space, famous movies, unusual animals, or curious details from everyday life.

Whether you have a few free minutes or feel like exploring question after question, Magic Quiz makes it easy to follow your curiosity. Its clean, shimmering design keeps the focus on the most rewarding part of any quiz game: the moment an answer becomes a discovery.

There is always another curious question waiting to reveal its secret.

Download Magic Quiz and discover what your curiosity will uncover next!

apps.title: Idle Mining & Refining
apps.summary:
Turn raw ore into profit in Ore Mining & Refining, a relaxing idle game filled with moving machines, satisfying crushing and rewarding upgrades!

Tap to drop ore from above and watch it travel through your production line. Pistons, spinning mechanisms and conveyors push each piece toward the crusher, where raw ore becomes valuable metal. Your robots carry the finished metal to the bank, earning you money to upgrade your machines and keep production growing.

⛏️ TAP AND KEEP THE ORE FLOWING

Every production run starts with raw ore. Tap to drop more pieces onto the level and watch your machines move them along. Follow their journey from rough rocks to refined metal!

⚙️ WATCH YOUR MACHINES AT WORK

Let pistons push, mechanisms spin and conveyors carry your ore toward the crusher. Enjoy watching the different parts of your production line work together, moving one piece after another through the level.

💥 CRUSH ORE INTO VALUABLE METAL

Deliver raw ore to the crusher and watch it break into processed metal. Turn a growing stream of rocks into a satisfying flow of valuable materials, ready for your robots to collect.

🤖 COLLECT, DELIVER AND EARN

Your robots handle the next step! Watch them pick up the finished metal and carry it to the bank. Every delivery earns money that you can put straight back into your production line.

📈 UPGRADE YOUR ENTIRE OPERATION

Spend your earnings on improvements throughout the level. Upgrade your ore supply, transport mechanisms, crusher and robots to keep materials moving and make your operation more productive.

🌎 PROGRESS THROUGH DIFFERENT LEVELS

Move on to new levels with different layouts and watch your production take shape. Keep upgrading as you discover the next setup of machines and ore-processing action.

🎮 GAME FEATURES:

• Tap to drop raw ore onto the level
• Move materials with pistons, spinning mechanisms and conveyors
• Crush ore and extract valuable metal
• Watch robots collect and deliver your finished materials
• Earn money and upgrade every part of your production line
• Progress through levels with different layouts
• Enjoy relaxing idle gameplay and satisfying machine action

From the first falling rock to the final robot delivery, every step brings you closer to a bigger and better operation. Keep tapping, keep crushing and keep upgrading!

Start your production line in Ore Mining & Refining!

apps.title: SoEasy Mahjong 2: Make Ten
apps.summary:
Ready for a new kind of Mahjong puzzle? 🀄

SoEasy Mahjong 2: Make Ten combines classic Mahjong tile matching with a fun number puzzle twist. Match identical tiles, pair special tiles, or combine number tiles to make 10. Find the right matches, clear the board, and enjoy a fresh puzzle experience with every level.

Mahjong Matching with a Twist

Discover more ways to match and clear tiles:

• Match Identical Tiles — Find two tiles with the same design and clear the pair.

• Make 10 — Combine two number tiles that add up to 10, such as 8 + 2, 6 + 4, or 7 + 3.

• Match Special Tiles — Spot themed tiles and pair matching designs to clear the board.

Each board offers different matching opportunities. Look carefully, choose your next move, and find the best way to clear the tiles. 🔍

Easy to Learn, Fun to Solve

Enjoy the familiar look of Mahjong tiles with a fresh tile-matching puzzle mechanic. Whether you prefer spotting identical tiles or finding number pairs that add up to 10, every move gives you a new way to approach the board.

The rules are simple to understand, but finding the right matches takes observation and planning. Think ahead, explore different combinations, and enjoy the satisfaction of clearing tiles one pair at a time.

How to Play

• Find tiles that can be matched.
• Pair identical Mahjong tiles or matching special tiles.
• Combine two number tiles that add up to 10.
• Choose your matches carefully to clear the board.
• Complete each puzzle by clearing the tiles.

Match, Think & Relax 🍃

Looking for a relaxing Mahjong puzzle, a casual tile-matching game, or a fun number puzzle? SoEasy Mahjong 2 brings them together in one easy-to-play experience.

Enjoy familiar Mahjong-style tiles, satisfying matches, and the added challenge of making 10. Take your time, find the right combinations, and clear each board at your own pace.

Start your Mahjong puzzle journey today and see how far you can go! 🎯

apps.title: BallSZN: Basketball Career
apps.summary:
Live your basketball career from high school to the pros in BallSZN, said "Ball Season". Play real 3v3 basketball games, get recruited by colleges, hear your name on draft night and chase the Hall of Fame in a career simulator that plays fully offline.

HIGH SCHOOL TO THE PROS
Start in your parents' backyard with a ball and a hoop. Earn your recruiting stars in high school, pick your college on signing day and hear your name called on draft night. Make the league or fight your way up from the Development League, negotiate in free agency and chase a ring, all the way to the Hall of Fame.

REAL BASKETBALL GAMES, FAST
Every game day is a real 3v3 game with five a side: two 2-minute halves, 2s and 3s, a 12-second shot clock. Start on the bench, earn your minutes and stay on the floor by how you play. Move with your left thumb, hold SHOOT to rise and let go at the top of the jump on the timing meter. A game takes about five minutes and seasons are short, so you play the moments that matter, not 48-minute grinds.

HOW YOU PLAY DECIDES YOUR ROLE
After every game a teammate grade, A+ to F, judges what you did: the makes, the extra pass, the stops and the boards. It sets your XP and what your coach thinks of you, and teammates who trust you look for you more. Every teammate and opponent has his own game and his own numbers, and they grow, fade and move on between seasons.

BUILD YOUR PLAYER
Pick one of six player types, from Sharpshooter and Slasher to Playmaker and Iceman. Practice with the team, run the drills and watch your stats and OVR climb. Earn your role from the bench up to Star and Franchise Player.

LIFE AROUND THE COURT
Keep your coach, your teammates, the fans, your girlfriend and your sponsors happy, and see it all on the feed. Earn a salary and playoff bonuses, upgrade your home court from the backyard to your own facility, and save up for the house.

QUICK PLAY
Just want a game? Jump into a 1v1 or a 3v3 basketball game whenever you like.

FAIR BY DESIGN
- Plays offline, no wifi needed. No account, no sign-in.
- Your basketball career is saved on your device, so no server shutdown can ever take it away.
- No VC and no pay-to-win. No ads. The whole career is free, with one optional purchase: BallSZN Pro.
- No energy timers.

Teams are named only after real cities and states. No real leagues, team names, logos or players are used, and nothing is licensed from or endorsed by any league.

Privacy Policy: https://ballszn.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://ballszn.com/terms
Support: https://ballszn.com/support
Contact: support@ballszn.com

Crime City: Zombie Shooter is a fast-paced action game built around missions, combat challenges and exciting city adventures. Choose your mission, prepare your weapons and take on different challenges across a stylized urban environment. With multiple game modes, varied objectives and quick gameplay sessions, every mission offers a new way to test your aim, movement and strategy.

Zombie Survival
The city is facing a growing zombie threat. Enter the Zombie Survival mode and prepare for challenging waves of incoming zombies. Stay alert, manage your position and use your weapons carefully as each wave puts your skills to the test. Stay alert, move carefully and survive each round as the challenge continues to increase. Use your equipment wisely, keep your distance and adapt your strategy as you progress through the waves.

Dead Zone
Enter the Dead Zone for a focused mission where every move matters. Navigate the area, deal with enemy encounters and work toward completing your objective. Pay attention to your surroundings and choose your approach carefully. Each mission creates a new challenge that keeps the action moving.

Mega Ramp
Take a break from combat and jump into Mega Ramp. Drive across challenging ramps, navigate obstacles and keep your vehicle under control as you make your way through each course. Time your movements, stay on the track and overcome every obstacle standing between you and the finish.

A City Full of Missions
Crime City: Zombie Shooter combines different types of action into one mission-based experience. One moment you may be surviving a zombie wave, the next you could be navigating the Dead Zone or taking on a high-speed Mega Ramp challenge. Each mission gives you a clear goal and a different scenario to experience. Progress through the game, discover new challenges and keep pushing your skills further.

Choose Your Approach
Different missions require different strategies. Think about your surroundings, manage your movement and decide how you want to approach each challenge. Whether you enjoy survival challenges, action missions or fast-paced driving, there is always something different to try.

Keep Moving Forward
Complete missions to progress through the game and take on increasingly challenging scenarios. Learn from every attempt, improve your strategy and see how far you can go. • Upgrade intake, exhaust, ignition, fuel, cooling and boost parts

• Certify each engine for power and efficiency, then build the next one

TUNE
• Dial in air/fuel, spark advance and cam timing by hand
• Choose piston crowns, engine shapes and firing orders
• Race rival engines up the dyno league, from Rookie to Legend

COLLECT AND RESEARCH
• Open toolbox chests and collect 56 part cards in 5 rarities
• Research lasting upgrades in the R&D Lab, even while you are offline
• Daily goals and free daily chests
• Rebuild as Mk II, Mk III and beyond, and keep your cards and research

• Offline earnings while you are away
• Calm, clean visuals and satisfying engine sounds
• No account needed. Your progress is saved on your device.
• Perfect for fans of idle games, tycoon games, car games and engine simulators

apps.title: GoreBox 27
apps.summary:
GoreBox 27 is a physics sandbox shooter. Every character is a GoreDoll: a full ragdoll with its own skeleton, organs and blood.

Play alone, against bots or online with other players.

DAMAGE
• Damage is tracked per body part: broken bones, failing organs and blood loss from each wound
• Lose the arm holding a gun and the gun falls. Lose the legs or break the spine and the GoreDoll crawls
• Knockouts, concussions and bleeding out, with GoreDolls that wake up and get back on their feet
• Blades and axes take off arms, legs and heads, and explosions tear bodies apart
• Wounds and burns stay on bodies, and blood stays on the ground
• Your own character takes the same damage, down to bruises and torn clothing
• The Body Inspector shows a body's vitals and organ function, and Status Indicators show how your character feels

FIRE, EXPLOSIVES AND RADIATION
• Fire spreads through grass, wood, cloth and spilled fuel, and smoke fills rooms and chokes GoreDolls
• GoreDolls catch fire and burn to death unless the fire is put out
• Explosives from propane tanks and gas cans to missiles, the Neutron Bottle and the Aerial Bomb, a nuclear bomb
• Radioactive fallout drifts with the wind, causes radiation sickness and can turn GoreDolls into Mutants

WEAPONS AND PROPS
• Firearms with recoil and handling based on real calibres
• Bullets go through walls, depending on the calibre and the wall's thickness
• 25 melee weapons, from the Katana to the Frying Pan, with heavy swings and blocking
• The Reality Crusher: grab anything physical, fling it, tear it apart or crush it, and build fences and walls
• Over 200 props, including turrets, TVs, live cameras, jump pads and teleporters

BOTS AND NPCS
• Ten kinds of NPC, from Regulars and Officers to Convicts, Maniacs, Mutants and Divines, each with its own background. Some fight back, some run and some surrender
• Bots take cover, react to gunshots, search where they last saw you, fight with melee weapons and man turrets
• Set each NPC's skill, and save an NPC with its weapons, look and side as your own spawn card

MULTIPLAYER
• Crossplay between PC and mobile
• Host a game for friends, invite them from your friends list, or browse public servers
• Dedicated servers, LAN games, voice and text chat, and vote-kicks
• Hosts set the rules, kick players, sell roles and run their server's own money, GB$
• Clans, each with its own bank and emblem

GAMEMODES
• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Free for all, Team deathmatch, Gun Game, Maniac Mystery, Infection, Mutant survival, Juggernaut, Riot, Invasion and more
• Bots can fill in for players in any gamemode
• Make your own gamemodes from triggers and actions, with lives, teams, zones and secret roles

WORLD
• Day and night, with a moon that goes through its phases, and clouds, rain and storms
• A car to drive, which hurts whoever it hits and whoever is inside when it crashes

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the Map Editor on PC, with houses, working doors, lifts and water to swim in, and play them straight away
• Publish maps on the Workshop and play the ones other players made
• Save a scene with everything built in it, its NPCs and where everyone stands, and load it again later
• Customise your character down to the face, with hairstyles, beards, hats, masks and clothes in any colour

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
This is an early access version of GoreBox 27. You will run into bugs, and parts of the game are unfinished or still missing. Nothing you see here is final.

GoreBox 27 is only a few months old and has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now. New updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

GoreBox 27 contains graphic violence, blood and gore, and online interaction with other players. It is not made for children.

apps.title: The Last Walk: Survival Story
apps.summary:
The Last Walk is a zombie survival story game with real choices, set in a post-apocalyptic world. The army is evacuating the last civilians. Your wife and daughter climb onto the last truck. There is no room for you.

So you walk. Through dead suburbs, empty highways and burnt-out towns, all the way to the coast, across the sea, onto an island under siege, and beyond. More than 30 days of walking through a world overrun by zombies, and the story isn't over yet.

EVERY ENCOUNTER IS A CHOICE
A wounded stranger begs for a bandage. A lost child is starving. Raiders block the road. A bear escaped from the zoo sleeps across your path. A supermarket hands out free food, a little too freely. Swipe left or right: help or walk away, fight or run, trust or lie. Every choice changes your supplies, your health and the man you become.

SURVIVE THE ROAD
- Manage water, food and health: the road drains them every hour.
- Search the ruins, then buy and sell gear at the traders and markets.
- Arm yourself: nail bat, crowbar, machete, revolver, pump shotgun. Upgrade and reload them at the traders.
- Find a shelter before nightfall, or spend the night outside and fight the zombies, the Prowlers, until dawn.
- Meet people who walk with you for a while, and a stray dog who could change everything.

A FATHER'S STORY
Your family is alive, somewhere ahead. Keep your humanity or keep everything for yourself: the people you help, the ones you leave behind and the risks you take decide where your story goes.

MORE STORIES IN THE SAME WORLD
Other survivors walk other roads. Their stories take place in the same world and cross the main story. Unlock them by playing the main story or by paying.

FEATURES
- A zombie survival game and an interactive story, with real choices and no right answer
- More than 30 days of walking, and the story continues
- Several more stories to unlock by playing the main story or by paying
- Night fights, markets, weapons to upgrade and supplies to manage
- A side-scrolling pixel-art world with animated scenes
- Free to play, in short sessions
- Available in 31 languages

apps.title: Boom 15
apps.summary:
💥 Play a card. Make 15. Clear the table for a BOOM 15!

Boom 15 is a fast, friendly card duel built on one simple idea: add a card from your hand to cards on the table and hit exactly 15 to capture them. Sweep every last card off the table and it's a BOOM 15, the biggest play in the game.

🃏 How to Play:
• Play one card from your hand each turn.
• If your card plus any table cards adds up to exactly 15, capture them.
• No 15? Drop your card on the table, and try not to leave an easy 15 for your opponent.
• Capture every card on the table to score a BOOM 15.
• After each round, score points for BOOM 15s, the most cards, the most of the special suit, the special 7 and the most sevens. Reach the target score to win the match!

🔑 Key Features:

💥 BOOM 15!
Clear the whole table in one capture for an explosive bonus point.

👆 Easy to Learn
Cards that can make 15 bounce on the table, so you always see your options. A quick hands-on tutorial teaches you the rest.

🔄 ReDraw
Stuck with a cold hand? Swap it for fresh cards from the deck.

⚡ Quick Rounds, Real Choices
Pick the best capture, chase the sevens, and never leave an easy 15 behind.

🗺️ Duel Journey
Battle through increasingly tough challengers and face off against bosses for big rewards!

🏆 Leagues & Rankings
Win matches, climb the leagues, and earn prestige.

⭐ Achievements & Daily Goals
Chase BOOM 15s, grab the special 7, and collect daily rewards.

🎨 Collect Card Backs
Unlock and level up card back styles to show off at the table.

Whether you grew up playing cards with family or just love a quick bit of mental math, Boom 15 is easy to pick up and hard to put down.

🤔 Can you make it BOOM?

📲 Download Boom 15 and start capturing today!

apps.title: Sea Playground: Ship Sandbox
apps.summary:
Sea Playground is a ship sinking sandbox with real physics. Pick one of 12 ships, pick a tool and see what happens: the hull bends, cracks and floods, fire spreads, and the wreck goes all the way down to the seabed. No levels, no timers — just the sea, 12 ships and your curiosity.

SINK SHIPS YOUR WAY
• Summon the kraken: its tentacles grab a ship and pull it down — or break it in two
• Place timer bombs and wait — or place remote bombs and hit Detonate
• Strike an LNG tanker with lightning and watch the chain reaction
• Push one huge wave under a lake freighter and break it in half
• Set sails on fire with the laser, lift a hull with antigravity or blast it with antimatter
• 20 tools in total, including hammer, tornado, terrain, pull, snap and repair

REAL SHIP PHYSICS
Water pours in through every breach, the hull gives way and the sinking ship finds its own way down. Hit the same ship in a different spot and you get a different shipwreck — no two runs end the same.

12 SHIPS
Galleon, ocean liner R.M.S. Titanic, container ship, rescue boat, cruise ship, superyacht, battleship, LNG tanker, car carrier, lake freighter, paddle steamer and crab boat. Four ships are ready from the start; unlock the rest by watching a short ad.

SEA, WEATHER, DAY AND NIGHT
Calm water or waves, day or night. Call a big wave, a storm or a tsunami whenever you like. At night the deck lights glow and every explosion lights up the dark water.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
Restart with one tap and try the next idea. Sink it, patch it up with the repair tool or just watch the storm roll in.

Sea Playground is a ship sinking simulator for everyone who has ever asked “what if…?” Nothing is unsinkable.

Welcome to Pink Pour Water Sort, a relaxing water-sort puzzle game built around color sorting and careful pouring.

Your goal is simple: pour colored water between bottles until every bottle contains only one color. Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour the top layer of water. Water can be poured into an empty bottle or onto water of the same color. Each level presents a different color arrangement, so you need to observe the order of colors, use empty bottles wisely, and plan your moves carefully.

Each completed level unlocks an entry in the in-game CG gallery. These CG entries are collectible 2D game illustrations that serve as level-completion rewards. You can view unlocked illustrations in the gallery. The CG gallery is a reward and collection feature, while the core gameplay remains water sorting and color classification.

Game features:

Water-sort puzzle gameplay: select bottles, pour water, and sort colors.

Multiple levels with different color arrangements.

Complete levels to unlock in-game CG illustrations and gallery entries.

Undo and restart options to help you adjust your strategy.

Simple tap controls and liquid pouring animations.

Suitable for short breaks or longer play sessions.

Play at your own pace and solve each color-sorting puzzle.

Goal:
Separate the mixed colors so that every bottle contains only one color. Complete the current level to unlock the next level and its corresponding CG gallery reward.

This is a casual puzzle game focused on water sorting and color classification. The in-game CG illustrations are level rewards and collection content.

apps.title: Wordeex
apps.summary:
Ever been lost for words? Wordeex turns that feeling into a word puzzle game.

16 letters. A hidden set of words. Can you find them?

Each puzzle starts with a keyboard made from the letters of three to five hidden words. Your task is to find those specific words and use every letter.

Find a correct word and its letters disappear, leaving you with the letters you need for the remaining answers. But there’s a twist: a real word isn’t always one of the words you’re looking for.

Sometimes the answer jumps out at you. Sometimes you stare right at it and swear it doesn’t exist.

Then, suddenly, you see it.

That’s Wordeex.

EVERY WORD CHANGES THE PUZZLE
Vocabulary helps. Logic makes the difference. Find a word, watch its letters disappear and take another look at what’s left. Your next answer could be right there.

GUESS, RETHINK, TRY AGAIN
Haven’t found the right word yet? Keep going. Your previous guesses stay visible, and a counter shows when you’ve tried the same word more than once. Yes, it happens.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Take on the daily Wordeex, shared by everyone playing in the same language. Solve it and share your result with friends.

EXPLORE THE CHAPTERS
Work your way through puzzles with different levels of difficulty. Some reveal starting letters and word lengths. Others show only the lengths. The toughest reveal neither.

TEST YOUR SKILLS IN ACADEMY
Ready for a greater challenge? Academy is a competitive mode with no hints. It adapts to your skill based on your completion times and number of guesses. As you improve, tackle puzzles with less common words and solve tougher challenges to climb the leagues faster.

CREATE A CHALLENGE OF YOUR OWN
Build your own Wordeex and share it with friends or the community. Can they uncover the words you’ve hidden?

PLAY OFFLINE
No connection? Keep solving Wordeex wherever you are—even in airplane mode.

EXPLORE 27 LANGUAGES
Play in your own language or try one you’re learning. Each language has a dictionary of 3,000 common words. Some will feel familiar. Others might become new favorites.

ALL GAME CONTENT IS FREE
Earn coins by completing puzzles and spend them on hints to help you outside Academy. Wordeex includes ads and optional in-app purchases for coins, ad removal and bundles. You can also choose to watch a rewarded ad after solving a puzzle to double your coin reward.

Think you’ve cracked it?
Find the hidden words. Use every letter. Solve the Wordeex.

Terms and Conditions: https://wordeex.com/terms/

apps.title: THE GOAT: Sports Legend
apps.summary:
You're a teenager with a dream: becoming the greatest athlete of all time. The GOAT.

THE GOAT is a sports career simulator played one card at a time, a life sim where every swipe is a choice. Each card is a moment of your life: swipe left or right to decide. From the youth academy to your last match, every decision writes your story.

ONE CHOICE, REAL CONSEQUENCES
Junk food the night before the final? A huge party with training at 9 a.m.? An agent promising you the contract of a lifetime? Every decision moves your five gauges: Talent, Health, Mind, Social and Fame. Watch your money too: salary, bonuses, sponsors and the temptations of success.

CREATE YOUR PLAYER
Pick a ready-made talent or create your own player: boy or girl, face, first name, country and position. Choose your sport. In football (soccer), play as a striker, midfielder, defender or goalkeeper. Your character grows older season after season, and you can run several careers side by side.

SEVEN SPORTS, SEVEN CAREERS
Football, basketball, American football, baseball, cricket, ice hockey and rugby: every sport has its own cards, positions and stats. Big games are played live: the clock runs, the score moves, and key moments stop the match for a decisive card.

FROM THE ACADEMY TO THE TOP
Start in a youth academy, fight for your first pro contract, then climb from small clubs to the elite. Deal with the coach, training, injuries, national team call-ups, the press, fans, rivals and family. After each card comes your month in review: your games, your goals and your club's place in the league table.

TRANSFERS AND CONTRACTS
Clubs come knocking. A transfer you accept happens at the next window, mid-season or at the end of the season, with clubs named after cities all over the world. Stay loyal, or chase a bigger stage.

LIVE MATCHES
Some big matches are played live: pick the coach's plan, then swipe at each key moment. A shot, a tackle, a one-on-one with the keeper: your choices change the score.

A CARD GAME AND A COLLECTION
Every card you play for the first time joins your collection, from Common to Legendary through Bronze, Silver and Gold. Open a card to see what would have happened if you had chosen the other side. Super choice swaps the current card for a rarer one, and Go back replays your last card. Your feats earn feat cards, which give you an edge in your next career.

SEASONS, TROPHIES AND RANKINGS
Each season ends with your stats for your position (goals, saves and clean sheets for a goalkeeper) and your trophies: league titles, cups, international titles and individual awards such as top scorer or best goalkeeper. The rankings list real players only: World, Legends, Top scorers, Playmakers and Goalkeepers. They move day by day.

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
After a live match, send the same match to a friend with a link and see who does better.

ENERGY
Your first cards are free, and free cards come back over time. To keep going without waiting, each decision uses energy: energy packs in the shop, and free energy every day with the daily bonus.

UNLIMITED CHARACTERS
3 characters are free. The optional Unlimited characters subscription lets you play as many as you want, with no ads interrupting your game (the reward videos you choose to watch stay available).

• A sports career from the academy to retirement, one card at a time
• Live soccer matches decided by your choices
• More than 1,000 cards to collect, from Common to Legendary
• Available in 31 languages

An internet connection is required: the league regularly records your games. THE GOAT is free to download, with in-app purchases and ads. Clubs carry the names of cities; the clubs, players and competitions in the game are fictional.

apps.title: MapTap.gg
apps.summary:
MapTap is a daily geography game. Every day you get five places tied to real events from that exact date, and the game is to find each one on a 3D globe. Tap where you think it is. The closer you land, the higher you score. Then you read what actually happened there: a shipwreck, an invention that failed twice before it worked, a border that moved overnight, someone nobody has heard of who changed something you use every day.

It takes about 2 minutes to play. Tomorrow there are five more, and five more the day after that. Keep a streak alive, see how your score sits against everyone else who played that day, or just against players near you. When 2 minutes is not enough, there is a lot more globe. Practice maps run from plain drills to journeys you retrace one stop at a time: Magellan's expedition, Darwin's voyage on the Beagle, Nellie Bly's race around the world, Ibn Battuta's travels. Find the Flag is a daily of its own. Gauntlet is a timed run at a set of locations everybody gets on the same day. Frontier is a survival run where one bad guess ends it. Versus puts you head to head with another player over five locations, with a rating that follows you around. Flashcards drill a map until it sticks.

There are hundreds of achievements to discover. You can build maps for other players, and play other players' maps!

MapTap plays in 12 languages. MapTap+ is an optional subscription that adds sharper satellite detail on the globe, the full run of practice maps, private groups to play alongside friends, the last 90 days of games you missed, drill sets you build yourself, and the curated Best of MapTap collection.

The daily game is free, and there are no ads in it anywhere, for anyone, ever.

apps.title: Arrow Challenge Master & Home
apps.summary:
Get ready for a addictive Arrow Puzzle Game that puts your brain to the test! Arrow Challenge Master & Home challenges you to clear crowded boards by tapping arrows in exactly the right order. It looks simple, but one wrong move and you're stuck — this is Brain Training at its most satisfying.

CLEAR THE GRID, ONE MOVE AT A TIME

Every level drops you into a tightly packed grid of directional arrows. Your job: spot which arrow has a clear runway and tap it to send it flying off the board. Clear the wrong one first and you'll box yourself in — so slow down, scan the grid, and plan your route before you tap.

• Scan the board for arrows with an open lane
• Tap to launch them off the grid
• Sequence your moves to free up trapped arrows
• Watch your lives — a bad tap costs you one
• Stuck? Use a Power Hint to reveal your next best move
• Empty the board completely to unlock the next stage

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO PUT DOWN

Arrow Challenge Master & Home mixes the pick-up-and-play feel of casual Tap Games with real Puzzle Strategy underneath. A single smart tap can open up three new options — and a single careless one can lock the whole board. Read the grid, work from the edges in, and turn chaos into a clean, empty board.

SMART HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT

No level should bring your progress to a halt. Tap the Hint button anytime you're stuck to reveal a safe next move, or turn on Guide Mode to see arrow paths highlighted before you commit. Both tools keep you moving without solving the puzzle for you.

WHAT MAKES IT FUN

• One-tap controls that anyone can pick up instantly
• Hundreds of hand-crafted grid layouts that get trickier as you go
• Real strategy — move order decides win or lose
• Built-in Hints and Guide Mode for tough spots
• A lives system that keeps every tap meaningful
• Crisp animations and satisfying feedback on every clear
• Bite-sized levels perfect for a quick break or a long session
• A genuine mental workout that sharpens focus over time

A PUZZLE THAT GROWS WITH YOU

This isn't a one-trick board. As you climb through the levels, grids get denser, arrow patterns get sneakier, and the margin for error shrinks. Every stage rewards players who think two or three moves ahead instead of tapping at random.

Daily reminder
Set a daily reminder for your routine, choose a convenient time and receive an alert so you can remember your planned game session

If you love brain teasers, direction-based logic games, or the simple joy of clearing a messy board down to nothing, Arrow Challenge Master & Home was built for you.

Download now and see how far your focus can take you — one arrow at a time!

Every day, one question. Answer it honestly for yourself - then the real game: predict what percent of everyone else said the same. apps.title: Street League Football
apps.summary:
Arcade American football on a street field, where every catch, tackle and juke comes from physics. Chase a high score in Endless, take the hit in Tackle Alley, and win 1v1 route battles online or against the CPU.

Players' bodies and the ball actually collide, so no two plays look the same. Run up a wall, go up one-handed over a defender, or truck the tackler and keep going.

MODES
- Endless: CPU opponents get tougher every round. Three strikes and you're out. Play offense, defense or both and climb the global leaderboards.
- Tackle Alley: carry the ball through a lane of tacklers, or line up as the defender and stop the runner.
- Route Battle 1 on 1: receiver against corner, eight reps, roles swap every two. Play online multiplayer with quick match or a room code, or take on four CPU difficulties.
- 3 on 3: squads, rush counts and route calls, online or against the CPU. Still being built.
- Practice: kickoff returns, quarterback drills and route work.

FREE TO START
The free download includes the tutorial, Tackle Alley with one tackler, Route Battle 1 on 1 against Rookie and Street CPU opponents, and the replay editor. One Full Game purchase unlocks Endless, 3 on 3, kickoff returns, quarterback and route practice, online play, more Tackle Alley defenders, and Legend and Insane CPU difficulty. No ads and no subscriptions. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

MORE
- Replay editor: rewatch any play from new camera angles in slow motion, then save and export the clip.
- Locker: build your player's body, head, hair, gear, cleats and colors.
- Touch controls built for landscape, with a layout editor to move every button. Controllers work too.
- Cross-platform online matches.

Online play needs an internet connection and uses Epic Online Services. Found a problem? Use the in-game Feedback button.

apps.title: King Dies Rich: Roguelike TD
apps.summary:
The king will fall. His fortune won't.

King Dies Rich is a pixel-art roguelike tower defense where the king himself is the tower. Hold the throne against the undead, find powerful loot, and turn every defeat into a stronger kingdom: castle defense, roguelite, and RPG in one game.

HOLD THE THRONE
Your king stays on his throne as enemies close in from every side. Slide a finger to guide the attack circle while he strikes automatically. Pick the most dangerous targets, break up the horde, and survive the next boss. Choose drag or direct touch aiming to suit your play style.

SEVEN SCHOOLS OF POWER
Shape your build with Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Guard, Blades, and Spirits. Burn the undead, freeze a crowd, unleash chain lightning, or surround the throne with blades and spirit archers. Equip matching gear to unlock Mastery and Dominion powers, from falling meteors to volleys of spectral arrows.

LOOT, EQUIP, REFORGE
Collect gear with different bonuses and school effects. Compare finds, equip legendary items, upgrade your favorites, and reforge their properties. Set gems in the throne and combine them into stronger gems as your Kingdom develops.

BUILD A LASTING KINGDOM
Spend the gold you earn on the Arsenal, Citadel, Treasury, Forge, and Mines. Buildings provide lasting upgrades and unlock more ways to improve your king. Your gold, gear, gems, and Kingdom progress stay with you when a siege ends, even if the king falls.

DEEPER HALLS, DEADLIER BOSSES
Battle through the Throne Hall, Crypt, and Chapel. Defeat each hall's boss to open the next, then face tougher enemies in the next circle. Discover the Bone Giant, the Maned and Chained Ghouls, and the Mourner. Fill your Bestiary as you learn what each enemy can do.

KING OF KINGS
After the first circle, King of Kings opens: the weekly race. Compete with other kings and climb from the Bronze league to the Crown league.

PLAY OFFLINE
An offline game for phones and tablets in landscape, with touch controls, adjustable sound, and optional vibration. Only the weekly race needs an internet connection. No account required.

Hold a little longer. Find a better crown. Die rich.

apps.title: Dead Ahead: Roadside
apps.summary:
Dead Ahead: Roadside – Pixel Text-based Roguelike Adventure

The legendary Dead Ahead universe is back! 10M+ players have joined the franchise, but in this brand-new zombie game, most will still end up as bait for the hungry zombies. 🍖🍴
Can you survive the road, or will this classic pixel rpg mark your final stop? 🧟‍♂️

Key Features:

🎮 Chill & Savage 🎮
Face the post-apocalyptic world at your own pace. If you love casual idle games, you can master the loop day by day with seamless controls. Just pick your perks, sit back, and watch your squad carve through relentless zombie waves in one of the most exciting zombie apocalypse games around.

🤩 Choice & Consequence 💪
Every day on the road brings a new decision. Risk it all for a rare reward or play it safe and move on? Your choices in these random encounters shape every run. It is a dangerous walking dead world out there, but taking risks is the only way to progress in this deep roguelike pixel rpg.

⛏️ Perks & Builds ⚒️
Unlock game-changing perks and craft a lethal build for every encounter. Experiment with synergies on the fly – every run is a new combination. Build the ultimate setup to survive the brutal zombie waves and prove your tactical skills.

🤯 Roam & Ruin 🌍
Each run takes you deeper into the ruined world. Push through wrecked cities, highways, and swamps, adapting to shifting threats. No two runs are ever the same in these vast adventure games, making it a standout entry among modern zombie games.

🤝 Friends & Firepower 💥
Unlike most zombie apocalypse games, this road is not yours to walk alone. Recruit fellow survivors who fight by your side with skills of their own. Level up your crew, unlock their perks, and get ready to fight back the walking dead hordes.

💰 Idle & Armed 🎖️
Collect your AFK rewards and gear up. As one of the most satisfying idle rpg games on mobile, every return makes you stronger. Unlock unique gear for your idle zombie build and prepare for the road ahead.

Will you survive this roguelike zombie game with brains… or just bullets? 🧟‍♂️
Enjoy these idle rpg games! The adventure games and idle games mechanics blend with pixel-style zombie games. Build your ultimate idle zombie hunting squad and defeat the zombies!

apps.title: Word Connections Master
apps.summary:
🔍 What do some words have in common that others simply do not?

That question is at the heart of every puzzle in Word Connections Master, the word game that trains you to see what is hiding between the words.

Every level places a group of words in front of you. Some seem completely unrelated. But look closer, and a connection begins to emerge. A hidden category. An association that was there all along, waiting for you to notice it.

🧩 HOW THE GAME WORKS
This word association game gives you a group of words and one goal: group them by their hidden connection. Four words per category. Multiple categories per level. Each correct association locks in. Each wrong guess makes you look again. The game never rushes you. It simply waits, patiently, for the moment the connection clicks.

And when it does? That feeling is unlike any other word game.

🔎 WHAT MAKES A CONNECTION?
In this game, associations come from everywhere. Sometimes the connection is a shared category, such as colours, animals, or countries. Sometimes it is a concept like: words that all follow something, or precede something, or describe the same feeling. Sometimes the association is so unexpected that you will stop and smile when you find it.

That is the magic of this word game. The connections are always logical. They are just not always obvious.

💡 WHAT YOU WILL DISCOVER
🔹Word associations you never knew existed
🔹Categories and connections that span language, culture, nature, and everyday life
🔹A new way of reading words, not just for meaning, but for the hidden relationship
🔹How much your vocabulary and general knowledge can surprise you
🔹That the most satisfying game moments come from connections you almost missed

🎯 WHAT THE GAME BUILDS
🔸Stronger word association skills with every puzzle you solve
🔸A richer vocabulary and deeper understanding of language
🔸Pattern recognition that sharpens the more you play
🔸A calmer, more curious way of approaching problems
🔸Confidence in finding connections where others see none

📦 WHAT IS INSIDE
🔹Hundreds of word association puzzles across dozens of unexpected themes
🔹A game that grows in depth the further you explore
🔹Progressive difficulty, early connections welcome you, later ones will make you wonder
🔹A gentle hint system that nudges without spoiling the association
🔹New word connections and game puzzles added regularly
🔹Clean, minimal design that keeps the focus on the words

🌟 A WORD GAME THAT ASKS MORE OF YOU
Most word games ask you to spell, or to guess, or to find. Word Connections Master asks you to understand — to see the relationship between words that, on the surface, share nothing at all.

It is a game about curiosity. About the pleasure of a pattern recognised. About the quiet thrill of a connection finally made. How many will you find?

👉 Download the game for free. Your favourite word association is waiting.

📧 We're always improving and genuinely love hearing your feedback. If you have any suggestions or feedback, write to us at support@quriousbit.com

apps.title: Sweet Spot
apps.summary:
Sweet Spot: Thrilling Visual Spot-the-Difference Adventure
Fed up with ordinary find-the-difference games? Come explore Sweet Spot! This high-definition visual puzzle game blends laid-back leisure fun with mind-teasing challenges. Hunt for carefully concealed tiny differences within gorgeous illustrations and dynamic video clips to hone your observation and quick response skills, and enjoy delightful puzzle entertainment whenever and wherever you want.

### Two Game Modes for Seamless Switching
**Still Image Mode (Casual Relaxation)**
Huge library of HD static puzzle levels with zero time limits. Take all the time you need to spot subtle distinctions in texture, lighting, color and fine details. Ideal for unwinding during breaks and practicing your observation skills without pressure.

**Live Video Mode (Reaction Challenge)**
Found static puzzles too simple? Try fast-paced video challenges. Spot momentary differences in moving footage to put your eyesight and reflexes to the test. You receive 3 free attempts each day. Once these are used up, view short ads to gain extra tries.

### Reward & Unlock System
Beat levels to unlock exclusive bonus videos and expand your gameplay experience. Two ways to unlock content:
- Free Path: Watch short video advertisements to unlock bonus videos
- VIP Benefits: Subscribe to VIP to instantly unlock all bonus videos and play without ads

### In-Game Content Gallery
The built-in gallery automatically stores every unlocked image and bonus video. You can view and sort your collection at any time, and save your favorite materials locally to keep them forever.

### Core Highlights
- Premium HD Visual Quality: Carefully refined art resources offer sharp, rich graphics for an amazing visual experience
- Carefully Tuned Difficulty Gradient: Easy for new players to get started, while seasoned puzzle enthusiasts can get satisfying challenges
- Immersive Sound Design: Calming background music matched with clear in-game feedback sound effects
- Ongoing Content Updates: Fresh levels and artworks are added on a regular basis

### Suitable for All Casual Gamers
Whether you are a puzzle fan, looking to relieve stress, or love beautiful visuals, this game will bring you joy. Simple, easy-to-use controls make it a perfect lightweight game to relax and exercise your eyesight.

### Service Promise
Sweet Spot follows positive and compliant service specifications. Focused on aesthetic enjoyment and observation training, all game content complies with platform rules. We rigorously safeguard user privacy and continuously polish game quality to provide a smooth, enjoyable gaming environment for every player.

Match each number to its color and watch quiet rooms, snowy streets, holiday keepsakes, and nostalgic scenes come to life. Enjoy classic paint by number gameplay with beautiful pages made for a calm and creative winter escape.

👗 Vintage
Color retro dresses, children in period clothes, and classic portraits. Lace, coats, hats, and old-fashioned holiday style bring a nostalgic fashion and lifestyle mood to winter coloring.

🏡 Home
Paint winter houses, fireplaces, cozy interiors, and Christmas decorations. Soft lamplight, stockings by the hearth, pine branches, and seasonal décor turn each room into a warm holiday scene.

⛄ Snowman
Bring snowmen to life with scarves, hats, carrot noses, and snowy yards. Color a single snowman or a complete winter scene with footprints, fences, trees, and fresh snow.

🎄 Christmas
Fill Santa, Christmas gnomes, Christmas trees, wrapped gifts, wreaths, ornaments, and festive decorations with color. Discover holiday scenes filled with ribbons, lights, greenery, and storybook charm.

❄️ Snow
Explore snowy landscapes, snow-covered mountains, winter forests, and quiet snowy fields. White trees, frozen paths, and open winter scenery create peaceful pages to color.

🔮 Globes
Color snow globes and crystal balls filled with tiny winter worlds. Swirling snowflakes, miniature houses, trees, and magical details make each globe feel like a small treasure under glass.

🕯️ Candles
Color candles, warm winter lights, and Bible verse lettering in peaceful seasonal scenes. Soft glow, wax, and meaningful words create a calm corner for reflective coloring.

🏙️ Streets
Walk through vintage towns and snow-covered streets in color. Shop windows, street lamps, old storefronts, and quiet roads bring nostalgic winter city charm to each page.

🐾 Animals
Color winter animals, birds, pets, and seasonal wildlife in cozy scenes. Choose a picture, follow the numbers, and complete the artwork at your own pace.

🌸 Flowers
Enjoy flowers, greenery, and botanical still lifes when you want something soft and pretty. Add color to delicate blooms and seasonal botanical details.

From a vintage dress to a snowy forest, from a cozy fireplace to a Christmas wreath, Winter Glow offers plenty of seasonal artwork to enjoy without complicated rules.

Choose a winter, Christmas, vintage, or seasonal picture
Fill each numbered area with the matching color
Watch the artwork gradually come to life
Complete your page and enjoy the finished scene

apps.title: Invokers: Titan Legacy
apps.summary:
Hack and slash your way through a vibrant fantasy world, battling epic bosses and hundreds of different enemies along the way. Crush waves of skeletons, goblins, and ogres – then face off against fearsome dragons, colossal giants, deadly demons, and much more.

Explore a vast world and discover a huge variety of stunning locations and enemies. Craft your perfect team: summon legendary Invokers and powerful Titans and experience the most exciting Action RPG combat on mobile – this is a true AAA mobile game. Adventure across tons of levels and beat huge dungeon bosses to win the best loot.

COLLECT INVOKERS & TITANS

Summon over a hundred Invokers from a variety of different Factions and customize your fantasy team: play as orcs, elves, humans – or someone a little more furry. And that's not all – summon powerful Titans and bind them to your Invokers to call upon legendary power.

INVOKE TITANS

When the time's right, unleash the ultimate power – Invoke a Titan and transform into a super powered fantasy creature to take down anything that stands in your way.

FIGHT EPIC BOSS BATTLES

Face off against classic monsters and bosses and experience the best boss battles on mobile! Go to war against the terrifying Corrupted Dragon, the cold-hearted Ice Queen, the merciless Demon Lord, and many more – in the best Action MMORPG battles around.

FAST-PACED ACTION COMBAT

Don't waste time taking turns – Invokers: Titan Legacy is all-action, all the time. Invokers takes all the tactics and strategy of turn-based battle RPGs, but boosts the excitement to a new level with fast, flashy, action gameplay.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TEAM

With billions of different team combinations and ways to develop your Invokers, you can play exactly how you want. Equip your team with powerful relics, then upgrade their skills to fit your strategy and tactics – bring deadly attackers, tough tanks, helpful healers, powerful sorcerers, or whatever you need to take down your next target.

CLIMB THE SPIRES

Craft the perfect strategy and build your teams to climb the towers to glory. Each legendary elemental tower requires a fully custom team. Master the elements and claim your victory.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Play how you want – whenever, wherever. Take full control of every Invoker, every skill, and every ability – or play on Auto mode to kick back, relax, and watch your awesome team do their thing.

And no internet, no problem. You can play Invokers offline – no matter where you are in the world. On a plane? At the bottom of the sea? Upgrade your experience with non-stop action-packed Invokers battles.

STUNNING 3D GRAPHICS

From the gorgeous, fully-animated 3D characters to the richly detailed, vibrant biomes, Invokers offers a vivid world you can immerse yourself in. And with thousands of unique skill animations and effects, action RPG combat has never looked more exciting.

EXPLORE A DEEP FANTASY WORLD

Get to know every Invoker in Amara, with fully fleshed out lore and bios for every single character – along with an expansive world map to discover. The world of Invokers is deep, complex, and rich with story.

apps.developer: The Wilder-ness, World Piece Computer, LLC
apps.summary:
Tea Garden Mahjong Alarm helps you handle alarms in a more active way.

If you tend to stop alarms too quickly and fall back asleep, this app gives you another option. Along with standard alarm controls, it can require a short mahjong tile match before the alarm ends.

Set the time, choose repeat days, pick a sound, and adjust vibration in just a few steps. For each alarm, you can choose a simple stop or a mahjong-based stop, depending on how much help you want getting fully awake.

The tile-matching wake-up step is short, clear, and easy to follow. It adds a little visual focus at the moment the alarm matters, without turning the process into something stressful or hard to use.

What you can do in the app

apps.title: Sort Streak: Color Puzzle
apps.summary:
🌸 SORT STREAK: COLOR PUZZLE 🌸

Sort, match, and arrange colorful flowers in a satisfying sorting puzzle adventure!

Sort Streak is a relaxing color sorting puzzle game and matching game that combines simple drag-and-drop gameplay with thoughtful planning. Colorful flowers are arranged on ropes, and your goal is to sort flowers by color, match them to the right rope, complete objectives, and fill flower pots.

The gameplay is easy to learn, but every move matters. Rearrange the flowers, manage limited rope space, and find the best solution for every puzzle level. Whether you want to relax or train your logical thinking, Sort Streak offers a colorful and satisfying puzzle challenge.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY

• Pick up a flower or a connected group of flowers from a rope.
• Drag the flowers onto an empty rope.
• You can also place them onto a rope with the same color at its free end and enough space.
• Sort and match flowers by color while carefully planning each move.
• Complete a full group of flowers on the matching rope.
• Watch the completed group collect into a flower pot.
• Complete all objectives and fill the required pots to clear the level.

Every move can change the entire board. Look ahead, rearrange the flowers, and use the available rope space wisely. If there are no legal moves left, the level ends. Can you overcome every sorting challenge and complete the objectives?

✨ WHY YOU’LL LOVE SORT STREAK

• Relaxing color sorting gameplay that is easy to learn.
• Simple drag-and-drop controls for an intuitive matching game experience.
• Colorful flowers, ropes, and satisfying sorting animations.
• Puzzle levels ranging from easy introductions to challenging arrangements.
• Different levels and layouts that keep the sorting adventure fresh.
• Helpful tools, including Hint, Undo, and Add a Rope.
• Satisfying flower grouping and flower pot collection feedback.
• A casual puzzle game for a quick break or a longer gameplay session.
• A fun way to practice logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving.

🔮 SPECIAL PUZZLE MECHANICS

Mystery Flowers add surprise to your color sorting adventure. Move the flowers underneath to bring a Mystery Flower to the end of the rope and reveal its true color. Once revealed, the flower can be sorted and matched according to the color rules.

Locked Flowers create new obstacles and objectives. Locked flowers cannot be moved until you complete the required color objective or the required number of group objectives. Unlock new possibilities, rearrange the ropes, and find a way through each challenging puzzle level.

As you progress, the flower arrangements become more complex. You will need to read the flower order, overcome obstacles, manage limited space, and choose every move carefully.

🧠 SORT, MATCH, AND TRAIN YOUR BRAIN

Sort Streak gives you a peaceful break while encouraging logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving. Take your time to sort colorful flowers, match the right colors, complete objectives, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of solving a puzzle.

Whether you enjoy sorting games, matching games, color sorting puzzles, brain teasers, or casual puzzle games, Sort Streak offers an easy-to-learn experience with satisfying challenges for every puzzle fan.

Can you sort every flower, overcome every obstacle, unlock every possibility, fill every flower pot, and solve every puzzle? 🌸

Start playing Sort Streak today and enjoy a colorful sorting puzzle adventure!
